purpose: Third round, on the WRDS release research7-data-2026-10 (original 300 names, 2018-2025): use I/B/E/S announcement times to place every trade exactly relative to the release, test longer pre-release holds, back-month calendars and surprise-based post-release trades, and replicate the research5/research6 leads with correct timing. Freeze policies now; their untouched final test is the expanded universe, which has not been downloaded or inspected.

data.quotes: OptionMetrics closing bid/offer, open interest, implied vol and delta; sessions E-10..E+5 around each I/B/E/S announcement date E; expiries <= E+45 days; strikes 0.7-1.4 x close; standard contracts only
data.ibes: Quarterly EPS actuals with announcement time (anntims) and the fpi=6 consensus history
data.validation_of_times: Before data use it was checked that the larger of the report-day and next-day absolute returns falls on the report day for 71% of before-open releases and on the next day for 80% of after-close releases; times are informative but not perfect.

prior_exposure: All 2018-2025 dates and the original 300 names were used by research4-6. Samples A-D here are therefore not pristine. Sample E (the expanded universe: 300 names ranked after the original at Dec-2017 plus up to 200 new top names at Dec-2020) has never been downloaded or inspected and is reserved as the untouched final test.

release_timing.rule: Let d = anndats and t = anntims (US Eastern). If d is a session and t < 09:30: P = session before d, Q = d (before open). If d is a session and t >= 16:00: P = d, Q = next session (after close). If d is not a session: P = last session before d, Q = first session after d. Releases with 09:30 <= t < 16:00 or missing t are excluded and counted.

information_set: As research5: decisions at a close use stock data to that close, quotes at that close, and earlier events whose Q session precedes the decision. Consensus uses only rows with statpers on or before the decision date. The reported EPS is used only by post-release trades (entry at Q or later).
execution: As research5: closing midpoints at entry and exit, $0.65 per contract per side, 25% and 50% half-spread sensitivities, unresolved exits counted and never dropped. A leg expiring on the exit date settles at intrinsic from the stock close (no exit commission).
signal_lag_check: Frozen policies are re-run with every decision taken one session before entry (contracts fixed then, executed at the next close; missing quotes cancel). Available for all entries because quotes start at E-10.

expiries.pre_release: front = first expiry with exdate >= Q date and <= Q + 10 days, quoted at entry
expiries.through_noncalendar: front = first expiry with exdate >= max(exit date, Q date) and <= Q + 30 days
expiries.calendar_front: first expiry with exdate >= Q date and <= Q + 10 days
expiries.back_1w: quoted expiry 6-8 days after the front
expiries.back_2w: quoted expiry 13-15 days after the front
expiries.back_month: first quoted expiry at least 21 days after the front
expiries.post_release: first expiry with exdate >= exit date + 1 day and <= exit + 21 days

pre_release.long_strangle: Buy put nearest S(1-0.5M) and call nearest S(1+0.5M), strictly OTM
pre_release.straddle_calendar_1w: Sell front ATM straddle, buy back_1w straddle at the same strike
pre_release.short_iron_fly_2x: Sell ATM straddle, buy wings nearest +/- 2.0 x straddle

through_release.atm_straddle_calendar_1w: Sell front ATM straddle, buy back_1w straddle
through_release.atm_put_calendar_1w: Sell front ATM put, buy back_1w put
through_release.atm_straddle_calendar_month: Sell front ATM straddle, buy back_month straddle
through_release.double_calendar_put_1w: Sell front call/put just outside +/- ATM put mid; buy the same strikes in back_1w
through_release.double_diagonal_put_1w: Sell front at the put edges; buy back_1w one quoted strike further out

post_release.post_iron_fly_1x: At Q: sell ATM straddle, buy wings +/- 1.0 x straddle
post_release.post_momentum_vertical: At Q: debit vertical (long ATM, short nearest beyond S(1 +/- M_Q)) in the direction of log(close Q / close P)
post_release.post_surprise_vertical: Same vertical in the direction of reported EPS minus the latest consensus mean before P

timings.through_noncalendar: entries P, P-1, P-4 x exits Q, Q+2, Q+4
timings.through_calendar: entries P, P-1, P-4 x exits Q, hold_front (front expiry close if on or before the Q+4 session date, else Q+4)

risk_normalization: As research5/research6 (debit; width minus credit; diagonals add the strike gap).

signals.M: front ATM straddle mid / stock close at the decision close
signals.J_k: log(close Q_k / close P_k) for earlier events (one release interval)
signals.R: M / H, H = mean over the last 8 earlier events (minimum 6) of E|J_k + sZ|, s = EWMA(0.94, 60 sessions excluding P_k..Q_k of earlier events) x sqrt(max(sessions from decision to front expiry - 1, 0)/252)
signals.HR: mean over the last 8 earlier events with quotes (minimum 4) of |J_k| / M_k, M_k = M at P_k for the pre-release front
signals.TSw: front ATM implied vol / back_1w ATM implied vol, own Black-Scholes inversion of mids (r=0, weekdays/252)
signals.D: implied ex-event diffusion vol from front and back_1w ATM vols / historical background vol (research6 definition)
signals.JM: post only: |log(close Q / close P)| / M at P
signals.SUE: post only: (reported EPS - latest consensus mean with statpers <= P date for the same fiscal period) / close at P

samples.A_selection: E in 2018-2021, research5 name half A
samples.E_untouched: Expanded universe, all years: evaluated only after this protocol's frozen file exists and only for frozen policies and the pre-registered replications

selection_and_gates: As research5: eligibility (>=150 issuer-events, >=40 issuers, <=1% unresolved, mean > 0 at 25% cost, mean > 0 excluding best 5), objective = cluster-robust lower 95% bound on A, freeze up to 5 (one per family). Qualification on B, C, D as research5, plus: in E, weekly-bootstrap lower bound > 0 at midpoint and mean > 0 at 25% cost.

replications.note: Pre-registered mappings of earlier leads onto release-correct timing, reported in every sample including E; not selected here.

limitations: Announcement times are retrospective I/B/E/S records; about a quarter appear inconsistent with the stock reaction day
Closing midpoint fills assumed; American exercise ignored except the dividend exclusion; settlement at the closing stock price ignores pin and after-hours risk
Samples A-D were all used by earlier rounds
